claims.object_text: adult male and female CDKL5-deficient mice (increased homotopic interhemispheric connectivity and functional hyperconnectivity across higher cognitive areas)
claims.quote: We found an increase in homotopic interhemispheric connectivity and functional hyperconnectivity across higher cognitive areas in adult male and female CDKL5-deficient mice by resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) analysis.

claims.object_text: CDKL5 is necessary and sufficient for proper CPN connectivity and cognitive function and flexibility

claims.object_text: selective re-expression of CDKL5 in the CPN subtype prevents cognitive impairments in otherwise CDKL5-deficient mice
claims.quote: when CDKL5 was selectively re-expressed only in this CPN subtype, in otherwise CDKL5-deficient mice, it was sufficient to prevent the cognitive impairments of CDKL5 mutants.
